aka.zh: 南港宜兰快速公路（规划名）

tagline.en: Taipei to the Lanyang plain under the Hsuehshan Range, through a 12.9 km tunnel
tagline.zh: 以 12.9 公里长隧道穿越雪山山脉，连通台北与兰阳平原

start.en: Su'ao interchange, Su'ao, Yilan, at the head of the Suhua Highway
start.zh: 宜兰县苏澳镇苏澳交流道，苏花公路北端

end.en: Nangang junction with National Freeway 3, Nangang District, Taipei
end.zh: 台北市南港区南港系统交流道，接国道三号

en: National Freeway 5 is 54.2 km of four-lane freeway from Nangang in Taipei to Su'ao in Yilan county — Taiwan's first freeway across from the west of the island to the east. It climbs out of Taipei through Shiding and Pinglin, goes under the Hsuehshan Range to Toucheng, and runs down the Lanyang plain past Yilan and Luodong.

Before it, Yilan reached Taipei by the Beiyi Highway, Provincial Highway 9, over the mountains, or the long way round the north coast on Provincial Highway 2. The freeway was planned to cut the trip to under 40 minutes. It is named after Chiang Wei-shui, the Yilan-born leader of the anti-colonial social movement under Japanese rule, and people speak of using it simply as "taking the tunnel".
zh: 国道五号自台北南港至宜兰苏澳，全长 54.2 公里，双向四车道，是台湾第一条横跨东西部的高速公路。它出台北后经石碇、坪林，穿过雪山山脉抵达头城，再沿兰阳平原南下，经宜兰、罗东。
在它之前，宜兰往台北只能翻山走北宜公路（台 9 线），或绕行北部滨海公路（台 2 线）。规划目标是把车程缩短到 40 分钟以内。路名纪念出身宜兰、日治时期社会运动领袖蒋渭水；民众口语上常以“走雪隧”代称走这条路。

en: Five tunnels carry it through the mountains: Nangang (about 455 m), Shiding (about 2.7 km), Wutu (216–248 m), Pengshan (about 3.8 km) and Hsuehshan. There are 40 bridges counting both carriageways and ramps; the Wutu River bridge in Shiding, 65.5 m above the ground at its highest, was the tallest in Taiwan until Freeway 6.

The Hsuehshan Tunnel is two bores, 12.942 km and 12.917 km, with a pilot tunnel of 12.941 km between them, linked by cross-passages every 350 m for people and every 1,400 m for vehicles. It is ventilated through three shafts, the deepest 512 m. When it opened it was Asia's longest road tunnel.

The ground was the problem. The line crosses six faults, 98 shear zones and 36 sources of high-pressure groundwater; at the east end one of the big boring machines met a water inflow of 750 litres a second in Szeleng sandstone. There were 63 collapses and the machines were trapped 26 times; on 15 December 1997 the one in the westbound bore was buried and written off. Work only sped up when a new face was opened from the No. 2 shaft and dug by drill and blast. By May 2000 the project was 33.6 per cent complete, and the tunnel opened eight years later than first planned.
Twenty-five workers, Taiwanese and Thai, died building the freeway; a memorial stands at Shiding service area.
zh: 穿越山区共有五座隧道：南港隧道（约 455 米）、石碇隧道（约 2.7 公里）、乌涂隧道（216 至 248 米）、彭山隧道（约 3.8 公里）与雪山隧道。桥梁连同双向主线与匝道共 40 座；石碇的乌涂溪桥最高处距地 65.5 米，在国道六号通车前是全台最高的桥。
雪山隧道由两条主隧道（12,942 米与 12,917 米）及中间一条 12,941 米的导坑组成，每 350 米设人行联络通道、每 1,400 米设车行联络道。隧道以三座竖井通风，最深的一号竖井达 512 米。通车时是亚洲最长的公路隧道。
难处在地质。路线穿过六处断层、98 处剪裂带及 36 处高压地下涌泉；东口的一部大型隧道钻掘机在四棱砂岩中遭遇每秒 750 升的涌水。施工期间共发生 63 次岩盘崩落，钻掘机 26 度受困；1997 年 12 月 15 日，西行线的一部被土石掩埋而报废。直到从二号竖井增开工作面、改用钻炸法，进度才明显改善。至 2000 年 5 月，整体进度只有 33.6%，通车比原定晚了八年。
兴建期间共有 25 名台湾与泰国籍工作人员殉职，石碇服务区立有纪念碑。

en: Studies of a tunnel road from Nangang to Toucheng began in 1982. The Executive Yuan approved a Nangang–Yilan expressway in 1988, and in August 1989 the transport ministry decided to build it as a full freeway and carry it on to Su'ao. Digging began with the pilot tunnel in July 1991; the main bores were started in July 1993.

The tunnel was called Pinglin until 2000, when people in Toucheng objected and President Chen Shui-bian proposed Hsuehshan instead. The pilot tunnel broke through in October 2003 and the main bores in 2004.

Nangang to Shiding opened on 27 January 2000 and Toucheng to Su'ao on 22 January 2006. A January 2006 opening of the tunnel was called off after criticism that fire and safety drills were incomplete; it opened on 16 June 2006, at first for cars only and at 70 km/h. Coaches were allowed from November 2007 and the limit reached 90 km/h in November 2010.
Two crashes stand out: a fire on 7 May 2012 inside the tunnel, the worst since it opened, which killed two; and a tour coach crash near Nangang on 13 February 2017 that killed 33.
zh: 南港至头城隧道公路的研究始于 1982 年。1988 年行政院核定南港宜兰快速公路计划；1989 年 8 月，交通部决议改按高速公路标准兴建并延伸至苏澳。1991 年 7 月导坑动工，1993 年 7 月主坑开工。
这座隧道原名坪林隧道，2000 年因头城乡亲抗议，由时任总统陈水扁提议改名雪山隧道。导坑于 2003 年 10 月贯通，两条主隧道于 2004 年贯通。
南港系统至石碇段于 2000 年 1 月 27 日通车，头城至苏澳段于 2006 年 1 月 22 日通车。原订 2006 年 1 月的隧道通车因消防与安全演练未完成遭批评而取消，延至 2006 年 6 月 16 日才开放，初期只准小型车通行，限速 70 公里。2007 年 11 月开放大客车，2010 年 11 月速限提高到 90 公里。
较重大的事故有两起：2012 年 5 月 7 日隧道内火烧车，为通车以来最严重的一次，2 人死亡；2017 年 2 月 13 日南港附近游览车事故，33 人罹难。

en: The freeway was built as two plans. Nangang–Toucheng, including the tunnel, was approved at NT$60.1 billion, revised to NT$58.8 billion and closed at NT$59.815 billion; Toucheng–Su'ao was approved at NT$27.46 billion and closed at NT$28.287 billion. The increases were put down to the long schedule, difficult geology, price changes and contract disputes.

The government tried private finance and failed. In 1997 the Executive Yuan asked for a build-operate-transfer study; Toucheng–Su'ao was put out to tender, drew one applicant, was widened to Toucheng–Hualien, and was dropped in January 2000 when no qualified bid arrived. In 2001 the Executive Yuan let the national freeway construction fund advance that year's money for Toucheng–Su'ao.

A 7 km link from the Su'ao end to the improved Suhua Highway was approved by the Executive Yuan on 12 November 2024, at NT$17.805 billion, 78 per cent from the national freeway fund and 22 per cent from the treasury, with completion targeted for 2032.
zh: 这条高速公路分两个计划兴建。南港头城段（含雪山隧道）核定经费 601 亿元，修正为 588 亿元，结案时为 598.15 亿元；头城苏澳段核定 274.6 亿元，结案时为 282.87 亿元。增加的原因包括期程长、地质艰困、物价变动及工程履约争议等。
政府曾尝试引入民间资金，但没有成功。1997 年行政院指示研析以 BOT 方式兴建；头城苏澳段公告征求民间参与后只有一家厂商申请，范围扩大为头城至花莲后又无合格申请人，2000 年 1 月终止。2001 年，行政院同意由国道公路建设管理基金先行支应头城苏澳段当年所需经费。
自苏澳端衔接苏花改的约 7 公里联络道，于 2024 年 11 月 12 日获行政院核定，总经费 178.05 亿元，国道公路建设管理基金负担 78%、国库拨充 22%，目标 2032 年完工。

en: In the tunnel the limit is 90 km/h with a 70 km/h minimum, lane changes are banned, and drivers must keep 50 m apart, or 20 m when traffic is crawling; cameras enforce all of it. Heavy goods vehicles are banned from the tunnel at all times and must use the Beiyi Highway or the north coast road.
The tunnel walls are painted with patterns from Indigenous dress so drivers can tell where they are.
zh: 隧道内限速每小时 90 公里、最低 70 公里，禁止变换车道，车距须保持 50 米，车速很慢时也须保持 20 米，均以照相取缔。雪山隧道全时段禁止大货车通行，大货车须改走北宜公路或北部滨海公路。
隧道内壁绘有台湾原住民服饰图案，让驾驶人辨认自己开到了哪里。

timeline.en: A feasibility study of a Nangang–Toucheng tunnel road begins.
timeline.zh: 南港头城隧道公路可行性研究展开。

timeline.en: The transport ministry decides in August to build a full freeway and extend it to Su'ao.
timeline.zh: 8 月，交通部决议改按高速公路兴建并延伸至苏澳。

timeline.en: The Hsuehshan pilot tunnel is started in July.
A boring machine is buried by a collapse in the westbound bore on 15 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 15 日，西行线一部隧道钻掘机遭崩塌土石掩埋报废。

timeline.en: Nangang to Shiding opens on 27 January; the build-operate-transfer tender is ended.
timeline.zh: 1 月 27 日南港系统至石碇段通车；BOT 招商终止。

timeline.en: The pilot tunnel breaks through in October.
Toucheng to Su'ao opens on 22 January; the Hsuehshan Tunnel and the whole freeway open on 16 June.
timeline.zh: 1 月 22 日头城至苏澳段通车；6 月 16 日雪山隧道启用，全线通车。

timeline.en: The tunnel limit is raised to 90 km/h on 1 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 1 日，雪山隧道速限提高为 90 公里。

timeline.en: A tour coach crash near Nangang on 13 February kills 33.
timeline.zh: 2 月 13 日，南港附近游览车事故，33 人罹难。

timeline.en: The link from Su'ao to the improved Suhua Highway is approved on 12 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 12 日，国五衔接苏花改计划获行政院核定。
